description: Infeasibility — dependency chain too long for available horizons + capacity
notes: Chain: phase1(4)->phase2(5)->phase3(6)->phase4(7). Only 2 horizons with capacity 4+5=9. Chain needs 4+5+6+7=22. Solver must drop lowest-value items. Best: phase1(4,5) in 0_3mo + phase2(5,10) in 3_12mo = 15 value, 9 effort. phase3+phase4 dropped. Actually phase1 effort=4 fits 0_3mo(4). phase2 effort=5 fits 3_12mo(5). That's exactly capacity. Total value=15.
